open_points.subject: ProjectValidationResult consistency across access policies
open_points.text: “admits the grant and assignment operations … only on an answer whose `exists` and `is_active` are both true … and uses only `status` (`active` or not) in the project guard”
open_points.question: What consistency constraints bind `exists`, `is_active`, `status`, and `failure`, and which field is authoritative if they disagree?
options: Require `exists = true`, `is_active = true`, `status = active`, and no failure to be equivalent facts
Allow disagreement and let access-management creation use `exists`/`is_active` while other project guards use `status`
Allow disagreement but define one field as authoritative for every policy
open_points.default_guess: Require coherent results: `is_active` is true exactly when the project exists with `status = active`, and successful facts carry no failure.

witness.initial: Registry returns `ProjectValidationResult(project_id=P, exists=true, is_active=true, status="archived", failure=None)` for a project; this shape is not forbidden by M17.
events: An administrator attempts to create a viewer grant for P.
The same or another authorized actor attempts a project mutation guarded by `status`.
outcomes: The grant is created because `exists` and `is_active` are true, while the mutation is refused because `status` is not active.
The validation result is rejected as internally inconsistent, so neither policy makes a business authorization decision from it.
witness.observer: The administrator and the affected viewer see whether a grant was created.

open_points.subject: Registry checks for revoking grants and assignments
open_points.text: M17 says “Portal mutation policy admits the grant and assignment operations of access management only on an answer whose `exists` and `is_active` are both true,” while R0-24 says revoking an existing viewer grant, staff assignment, or producer grant “does not consult the Registry and succeeds for an archived project, also while the Registry is unavailable.”
open_points.question: Does M17’s new requirement apply only to creation, or also to revocation and any other operation on a grant or assignment?
options: Apply `exists && is_active` only when creating a viewer grant, staff assignment, or producer grant; revocation never consults Registry
Apply it to both creation and revocation, overriding R0-24
Define separately which grant and assignment actions require Registry validation
open_points.default_guess: Read the new sentence as creation-only so that revocation retains the explicit R0-24 behavior.

witness.initial: An archived project P has an active viewer grant, and Registry is currently unavailable.
events: An administrator with access-management capability revokes the existing grant.
outcomes: R0-24: revocation succeeds without consulting Registry.
M17 read literally for all grant operations: revocation cannot obtain an answer with `exists` and `is_active` both true, so it is refused or fails.
witness.observer: The administrator and viewer see whether access to P remains active.
